title: Document to LLM Markdown input
description: Provide url for one document or urls for a batch. Public HTTPS destinations on port 443 only.

url.title: Single document URL
url.description: A public HTTPS HTML or PDF URL. Use this field or the batch field.

urls.title: Document URLs
urls.description: Up to 50 public HTTPS URLs. Duplicate URLs are processed once per run.

format.title: Output format
format.description: HTML supports Markdown structure or plain text. PDF output preserves extracted text by page without reconstructing document layout.

maxChars.title: Maximum content characters per document
maxChars.description: Unicode code-point budget shared across all PDF pages; excludes title and metadata. Truncating output does not reduce the number of PDF pages processed or billed.
